top_missing_areas: Design-system libraries: no publish/subscribe, publish status, library update transaction, detach source, usage analytics or style verbs (STU-DS-019..021, 137..143, 166, 187).

Plugin platform for design and graphics: no manifest, extension points, event subscriptions, per-node plugin data, plugin storage, plugin UI or quick-run; only the CLAP audio host exists (STU-AUT-017..019, 156..162, 196..198).

Scripting object model and command-contract depth: no suites, classes, primitive type system, command builder, descriptor path, enablers, scripted-command hooks, capability grants or promotion gate (STU-AUT-003, 007, 009, 116..124, 148, 150).

Variables, layout grids and handoff: no variable or collection commands, expressions, bindable-field sets, scope checks, layout-grid overlays, annotations, dev status, inspect/codegen or drift report (STU-DS-131, 133, 153..159, STU-AUT-024, 164..168).

CKC write-back and provenance: placements are file paths, not SPAL/asset/manifest links; exports are not registered in CKC, no derivation edges, no uncataloged-content report (STU-ASSET-005, 012..016).
